speaker: john_heminges
text: Egeon again. The same man as Monday. You open, and you wait, and the afternoon is the same shape.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same man. I am not rehearsing a wage into a part that already knows its length.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then do not. The speech is the speech. Monday did not improve it, and Thursday will not.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two Egeons in one week is a father's portion. I am not asking the father to be funnier. The twins will see to that.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book on the other matter can wait until I am at Aldermanbury with it open. This hour is the play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This hour is the play. I will hear the book when it is open, and not before.
